snippet.title: Prince Jackson Opens Up: Michael Jackson’s Legacy, the Michael Movie & Moments Fans Never Knew
snippet.description:
Prince Jackson joins us for an emotional and insightful conversation about the new Michael movie, the legacy of Michael Jackson, and what it meant to see his cousin Jafar Jackson transform into the King of Pop on screen.

In this wide‑ranging interview, Prince shares never‑before‑heard stories from the making of the film, including powerful moments on set, emotional performances recreated for the big screen, and the responsibility he felt as an executive producer protecting his father’s legacy. 

He opens up about the human side of Michael Jackson—his philanthropy, compassion, and impact on generations of fans around the world.

Prince also discusses:

- Watching the Michael movie for the first time
- Jafar Jackson’s dedication and performance
- Colman Domingo’s portrayal of Joe Jackson
- Michael Jackson’s influence on pop culture today
- Personal childhood memories, from toy store takeovers to quiet walks with his dad
- The mission behind Heal Los Angeles and continuing Michael’s humanitarian work
- What could come next in a potential Michael Part Two

This is a must‑watch conversation for Michael Jackson fans, music lovers, and anyone inspired by stories of legacy, family, and artistic greatness.

🎬 Watch, like, subscribe, and share with fellow MJ fans.

CHAPTERS:
00:00 – Prince Jackson’s Most “Michael” Childhood Memory
Toy store shutdowns, privacy, and growing up Jackson
02:01 – Seeing the Michael Movie on the Big Screen
Why IMAX matters and how emotional the experience was
03:14 – Jafar Jackson’s First Transformation Moment
The camera test that stopped Prince in his tracks
05:44 – Neverland, Havenhurst & Family Stories Fans Never Knew
The giraffe story, Disney inspiration, and MJ’s creative world

Join us for an exclusive Premiere interview with EJAE, the Grammy-winning singer/songwriter behind “Golden” from K‑Pop Demon Hunters. JoJo dives deep into EJAE’s incredible rise—from writing songs for others to becoming a global standout voice.

✨ What you’ll hear in this interview:
• The real story behind her Grammy win
• Meeting Kendrick Lamar, Lauryn Hill & Ariana Grande
• How her mom accidentally leaked her wedding
• Her upcoming album and creative process
• Rewriting “Time After Time” after 8 years
• Her surreal Volvo campaign & seeing her face on Crypto.com Arena
• Oscar nomination reactions
• Her wild paranormal trainee story (seriously chilling)
• Her dream collaboration with Max Martin
• A heartfelt message to fans she calls her “wings”
